Conversation and per IP address, or once the day's budget is spent, get its unavailable
text; the first refusal or reply that finds the budget spent raises the Agent's alert and

200.description: Server-Sent Events. When admission control refuses the message, one `unavailable` event (`reason`: `budget_exhausted` when the Agent's daily Token Budget is spent, or `rate_limited` when the Conversation or the Visitor's IP address is over the Agent's rate limit; and as `message` the Agent's unavailable text); nothing is saved. Otherwise, for an Agentic Agent, a `search` event (no data) as each Knowledge Search starts, preceded by a `retract` event (no data) when the answer text streamed so far must be cleared, then `token` events (`text`), then `citation` events (`label`, `document_name`, `passage`; only when the Live Version shows citations) and one `done` event (`message_id`); or, when the answer leaks the Canary token, a `replace` event (`text`) then `done`; or, when the input Guardrail blocks the message, a `refusal` event (`text`) then `done`, and no model is asked; or, when the model provider fails, one `error` event (`code`, and as `message` the Agent's unavailable text, which names no model or credential).
